title: Mexican Duck Legs
description: A twist on traditional Mexican cuisine, this dish combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with the richness of duck legs.
instructions: Rinse the duck legs and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the duck legs.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck legs for 2-3 minutes on each side, until browned.
Transfer the duck legs to a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, until cooked through.
Remove the duck legs from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the duck legs hot, garnished with lime wedges and crumbled feta cheese if desired.
